findings.issue: The task requires the unknown-section error to list sections in Sections() order. The handler does this (prepare_section.go:180-190 iterates the slice it was given), but TestScenario8UnknownSectionListsSections only checks that each entry is present, so a change that reorders the list would still pass. Sorting by ID is Sections()' job under R13 and is tested elsewhere, so this does not block.
findings.fix: Optional: assert that the hint contains the exact text 'available sections: environmental (Environmental Disclosures), governance (Governance Disclosures)'.

findings.issue: The R12 mapping test does not check every field of Prepared. These are never asserted: finding kind/field/severity, fact key/label/unit, verbatim title, and item field_name/spreadsheet_id/sheet_id/before/after. The summary check covers field_name/before/after only indirectly, through Preview. Getting one of the unchecked fields wrong in newPrepareSectionOutput would not fail any test.
findings.fix: Optional: compare the whole structured output against an expected map with reflect.DeepEqual, or add asserts for the remaining fields.

findings.issue: The test uses unchecked type assertions such as out["findings"].([]any) and facts[0].(map[string]any). A shape regression panics the test instead of failing it with a readable message.
findings.fix: Use the comma-ok form and call t.Fatalf on a mismatch, or decode the structured content into prepareSectionOutput and compare fields.

findings.issue: The test matches the JSON-escaped form `unknown section ID \"nope\"`, so it depends on the error envelope's encoding and not on the message itself.
findings.fix: Parse the error envelope with json.Unmarshal and assert on error.message and hint, or match only the unquoted parts.

findings.issue: The hand-written known-section loop could be slices.ContainsFunc, which says the intent in one line.
findings.fix: known := slices.ContainsFunc(sections, func(s recipe.SectionInfo) bool { return s.ID == in.SectionID })
